name: cineweave-studio
description: CineWeave Studio is a composable creative Skill system for independent character, scene, style, direction and production workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Composable creative workflows for images, video and production design.
interface.longDescription: CineWeave Studio v2 provides an optional $cineweave entry point plus five independently usable specialist Skills. Character supports zero-prompt discovery, user-led preference convergence, reusable identity and performance; Scene owns geography and physical interaction; Style owns visual and temporal style systems; Director owns shot language, prompts and storyboards; Production owns recipes, controls, evidence, capability, rights and evaluation. All composition passes through explicit versioned contracts, so a specialist can work directly from a brief or consume exact upstream artifacts without hidden state. The system remains provider-neutral, human-gated for execution and explicit about rights, evidence and capability limits.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $cineweave to turn my creative request or zero-prompt character feeling into an editable brief and the smallest independent or composed CineWeave Studio workflow.
